name: DG-56 5.56x45 Rifle
description_html:
By-product of my QBZ-97 project.

Rifles imported from fictional firearms manufacturor Defense Group in Call of Duty

A QBZ-97 repulica with more customization options.

Firemode has been changed to full-auto.

Installion:

Just like other mods. Unzip and drop Mass_DG56 folder into “[Your EFT Directory]/user/mods”.

You should be able to find it and its parts in Mechanic’s shop and on the flea market.

Models and textures are properties of Actvision;

Please give clear indication of the author or origin when reuploading on other websites or publicly sharing this mod.

Please do not publish mod containing files or their variants with the suffix .bundle within this mod without permission.
